name: Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS)
eligibility_facts: EWS non-minority participation only within stated component limits
questions: Which component do you need—skill training, education, or women’s entrepreneurship?
Do you belong to one of the six notified minority communities?

source_text_aliases: EWS non-minority participation only within stated component limits

question.en: Do you belong to one of the six notified minority communities, or qualify as an EWS non-minority candidate within the selected component's permitted limit?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଛଅଟି ଅଧିସୂଚିତ ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ସମ୍ପ୍ରଦାୟ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏର ସଦସ୍ୟ କିମ୍ବା ଚୟନିତ ଅଂଶର ଅନୁମୋଦିତ ସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ EWS ଅଣ-ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ପ୍ରାର୍ଥୀ ଭାବେ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ କି?

question.en: Does your age match your selected component: 14–45 for skilling or education, or 18–45 for women leadership or entrepreneurship?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବୟସ ଚୟନିତ ଅଂଶ ସହ ମେଳ ଖାଉଛି କି—ଦକ୍ଷତା କିମ୍ବା ଶିକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ୧୪–୪୫, କିମ୍ବା ମହିଳା ନେତୃତ୍ୱ କିମ୍ବା ଉଦ୍ୟମିତା ପାଇଁ ୧୮–୪୫?

description.en: The source reserves specified allocations for women and persons with disabilities; this is not a universal exclusion of other eligible applicants.
description.or: ଉତ୍ସରେ ମହିଳା ଏବଂ ଦିବ୍ୟାଙ୍ଗ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବରାଦ୍ଦ ରହିଛି; ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ଆବେଦକଙ୍କ ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ବହିଷ୍କାର ନୁହେଁ।
